Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’re finalizing the materials for the on-site on Oct 5 — target is a 9:00–2:30 exec session with three breakout tables afterwards. Two quick asks so we can send calendar invites to our execs this afternoon: 

1) Can you confirm a one-page reading pack (2–3 pages max) we can send to our C-suite that summarizes: workshop objectives, key questions we’ll address, required prework, and a short list of data artifacts they should skim? We need a draft by EOD Wed so we can circulate.

2) We’d like a simple "speaker lanes" doc that spells out who covers which 12–15 minute segment (owner, title, 2 bullets of talking points) so our moderator can prep transitions. If you can share a spreadsheet with lane owners, that would be ideal.

I attached our working agenda and a one-page background on the initiative.

Appreciate it — Jennifer
